posts.title: Three generations
alt: Portraits: The family. Three generations. One standard. The family behind The Lexington.
Portrait card: Mikhail Skarlatos. 1922 – Present. Senior Executive at Doxiades & Associates for 60+ years, responsible for city-wide planning and development of Tema from the ground up in the 1960s.
Portrait card: Leo Skarlatos. 1962 – Present. Designed the MTN Headquarters in Accra as CFO of MTN. Designed and financed the Silver Mountain Resort & Spa in Brasov, Romania.
Portrait card: Niko Skarlatos. 1992 – Present. Developed multiple world-class showrooms in London, Accra, and Abidjan; completed a six-bedroom residence in Shiashie, East Legon.
